name: ORF — Technische Produktionsrichtlinien / HDF01a File Delivery (HD)

governance.source: ORF Technische Produktionsrichtlinien zur Herstellung von Fernsehproduktionen (HDTV) [orf__tr_hdtv.pdf]; aligned with the joint ARD/ZDF/ORF Technische Produktionsrichtlinien and MXF profile ARD_ZDF_HDF01a (IRT)
governance.notes: ORF (Austria). Uses the joint ARD/ZDF/ORF technical production guidelines and the ARD_ZDF_HDF MXF profiles; ORF maintains its own file spec (beschaffung.orf.at). Video: MXF OP1a XDCAM HD422 (MPEG-2 4:2:2 Long GOP) 50 Mbit/s, 1920x1080i/25 TFF, 8-bit, BT.709, limited range (EBU R103); safe areas per EBU R95. Audio: PCM 24-bit/48 kHz, stereo standard (mono-compatible), multichannel 5.1/3.0 optional as discrete PCM or Dolby E; EBU R128 -23 LUFS +/-0.5 LU, true peak -1 dBTP. TC start 00:00:00:00 (ORF convention). No technical leader/bars for file delivery. Subtitles: EBU STL (shared ORF/SRF/ZDF subtitle presentation standards). Metadata: Medienbegleitkarte. PSE not specified. Language de, jurisdiction AT.

codec.notes: MPEG-2, 4:2:2, 8-bit, Long GOP, 50 Mbit/s (XDCAM-HD422 implementation, profile ARD_ZDF_HDF01a).

frame_rate.notes: 1080i/25 (50 fields/s). 1080p/25 is a special format carried and signalled as 1080psf/25 / 1080i/25.

codec.notes: Uncompressed PCM (discrete). Dolby E permitted for multichannel exchange.

track_count.notes: Discrete mono AES3 tracks per ARD_ZDF_HDF01a (8 tracks). Stereo mix mono-compatible; multichannel 5.1/3.0 optional (discrete PCM or Dolby E).

layout.notes: Stereo is the standard production/exchange format; must be mono-compatible. Multichannel (5.1 or 3.0) optional, preferably discrete PCM.

loudness.notes: Programmlautheit -23.0 LUFS +/-0.5 LU (EBU R128 / ITU-R BS.1770). Max true peak -1 dBTP.

subtitles.notes: EBU STL subtitles for the hearing-impaired; ORF, SRF and ZDF share common subtitle presentation standards. Audio description carried as an audio track.

timeline.notes: Continuous gap-free timecode; ORF start convention 00:00:00:00. Deliver clean with no technical leader/bars/tone.

luminance.tolerance_note: ITU-R BT.709-6 / EBU R103 (8-bit nominal black 16 / white 235). Headroom must not be used for artistic effect; nominal level only briefly above the valid range. Gamut error over >1% of picture area.
